_about: Golden fixture from the deployed CHAIR token on NEAR testnet: every transaction since `new`, with its events, and the contract's own views at one pinned block. The sim replays these transactions through its token model and must reproduce the contract's request bytes exactly. Fetched with archival-rpc.testnet.fastnear.com (same chain as test.rpc.fastnear.com).

The constitution, enforced by the token contract (anything outside it is clamped, never applied):
- tax_bps: tax on every buy and sell, in basis points. 100 to 300, moving at most 50 per meeting.
